subject: Partner SI workshop: Redwood/Acme joint architecture review
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Tan <sophia.tan@acmecloud.com>, Eng Team <eng@acmecloud.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@marketplace.io>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood / Acme: Joint SI workshop (architecture review)

Hi Sophia / Acme Eng,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — excited to get into a technical deep-dive with your systems and our runtime/serving patterns. We recommend a 90-minute joint solution workshop (Redwood + Acme SI + Marketplace) to cover:
- High-level architecture alignment (networking, VPCs, peering)
- Model serving topology (Dedicated vs Private options)
- Performance & scaling patterns (batching, KV cache, quantization impacts)
- Integration points for marketplace listing / provisioning flow

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 17: 10:00–11:30
- Wed Nov 18: 11:00–12:30
- Thu Nov 19: 14:00–15:30

Attached is a draft agenda (redwood-acme-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf). Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will join (networking, infra, marketplace eng). We can adjust duration if you prefer 60m.

Thanks — I can coordinate calendar invites once we lock a time.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-acme-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf

Quick asks so we can tailor the workshop:
- Can you share approximate QPS and expected peak sequence lengths? (sample anonymized traces OK)
- Any specific compliance or networking constraints (e.g., egress rules, private peering, customer-managed keys)?
- Who will own follow-up operational runbook updates on the Acme side?

I'll send a calendar invite with the final agenda. Attaching a provisional invite now (redwood_acme_workshop_invite.ics) — please accept if the time is good.
